outletShopriteBody: Walk into any Shoprite Ikeja aisle and a SEIRS driver can be at your door within the hour. We've stationed dedicated riders at the main entrance so there's no hunting for a bike outside.
1. Shop normally and pay at the till
2. Hand the receipt to the SEIRS rider at the entrance
3. Track the rider in this app until they hand the bag over
- Groceries, household, frozen, baby supplies, every SKU eligible
- Cold chain maintained for frozen and dairy items
- Pay at the till OR settle through SEIRS at delivery
- Book a pickup window that suits your shop
> We picked Shoprite first because their checkout staff already coordinate with delivery riders, so the handover takes seconds, not minutes.
Shoprite Surulere and Lekki branches open next month, followed by Ikoyi in July. We're also in talks with Spar and ShopRite Apapa.
Open Send a package to try it now.
tipScheduleBody: If you've been booking deliveries on the fly, here's an easy way to cut your bill: schedule the pickup an hour ahead. You get a 10% discount and your driver gets time to be there without fighting traffic.
Scheduled pickups let our drivers plan their route around multiple bookings. They burn less fuel between trips, so we pass the saving back.
3. Pick any slot between 5 AM and 9 PM
4. The 10% discount applies automatically, no code
- Weekday mornings between 9 AM and 11 AM, drivers are freshly active and roads have cleared
- Mid-afternoons (2-4 PM), between school runs and rush hour
- Avoid Friday evenings after 5 PM, that's our busiest window
> Customers who schedule even 60 minutes ahead see deliveries arrive 18 minutes faster on average.
featureMultistopBody: Need to drop off at five places in one trip? Multi-stop is built for exactly that, sending invoices across an estate, fulfilling a wedding-gift list, distributing church communion bags, or paying suppliers in one route.

You pay the route distance plus a small per-stop bonus (currently ₦300 per extra stop), far cheaper than booking five separate trips. The route is auto-optimised, so the driver hits the stops in the most fuel-efficient order.
- Up to 5 stops in one booking
- Different recipient name, phone, and notes per stop
Friday this week for customer accounts. Business accounts already have it, they've sent over 3,000 multi-stop trips since February.
> One construction firm in Lekki uses multi-stop to deliver materials to four sites every morning, they've cut their dispatch admin to under 10 minutes a day.
Tap Send a package on Friday to try it.
referralBody: Invite a friend to SEIRS and you both earn points the moment they complete their first booking. The more you invite, the more points you collect.
- Your referral bonus lands the moment a friend completes their first qualifying delivery
- 100 bonus points if they complete five trips in their first month
- There is a monthly cap on referral bonuses, so the programme stays sustainable
Your friend joins with 200 points already in their account, enough to cover a chunk of their first ride or delivery.
3. Apply up to ₦100 worth of points per booking
> A few customers in Yaba and Surulere have turned referrals into ₦10,000+ of credit just by inviting their WhatsApp groups. Worth trying.
Tap Send a package and check Rewards to start sharing your code.
